cases.trigger: First and repeated calls in one raw operation
cases.expected: One successful real advisor Enter, guarded reuse and one admission Dispose; no provider ownership transfer.
Profile unsupported; no fabricated input/no-op lifetime or constructor call.
Preserve failure, no phantom retained lease/receipt; actual in-flight work drains.

cases.trigger: Enter returns an admission while callback closes/cancels operation
cases.expected: No delivery; returned admission cleaned exactly once with correct raw lifetime accounting.

cases.trigger: Raw user callback/task completes while Enter is blocked
cases.expected: No new work/receipt; session drain/cleanup waits for callback to return and any admission cleanup.

cases.trigger: Raw user callback/task completes while constructor/evidence callback is blocked
cases.expected: Revoke delivery immediately; keep lease until actual provider call and cleanup complete.
Actual provider work/admission remains until real completion; no premature release.

cases.trigger: Raw cancellation while provider temporarily ignores token
cases.expected: Stop further guarded work after callback resumes; retain resource through its true completion.

cases.trigger: Session/operation close while a provider call is active
cases.expected: Reject new calls and keep actual owned handle alive until call exit; no double release.

cases.trigger: Provider lease/advisor revocation at any callback including false ownership
cases.expected: No result; availability failure precedence and proper eventual cleanup.

cases.trigger: Overlapping/reentrant provider-touching calls in one operation
cases.expected: Refuse second call before Enter/provider work; no callbacks under state gate.

cases.trigger: Independent raw operations on same supported bound advisor
cases.expected: Separate real admissions; no cross-operation receipt/admission reuse or hidden native-threading claim.

cases.trigger: Work failure plus lease Dispose failure
cases.expected: Original work exception first, cleanup failures in existing order; no swallowed background cleanup.

cases.trigger: Multiple Complete/close/drain paths and cleanup-only failure
cases.expected: Dispose admission once, preserve sole cleanup exception, settle drain once.

cases.trigger: Retain operation/receipt/copied value after raw completion
cases.expected: No active lease extension; new provider/authorization use refuses, copied payload readability is separate.

cases.trigger: Acquisition/close races with actual temporary resource handle
cases.expected: Real file/stream remains open while provider on stack, closes through original owner/admission path; no counter-only qualification.
